description.value:
Once per long rest, as a minor action on your turn, you close your eyes and exhale, putting yourself into a state of self-induced hypnosis. Through a mental technique passed down through generations, you distance yourself from reality in preparation for the violence of combat. As you open your eyes again, you act purely on instinct, becoming @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.Y822OUCDEPAG0HS8]{Frenzied}. 
You cannot exit the trance at will. However, at the end of each turn, you can make a DC 13 Wisdom (Save) check to end the frenzy. This check does not benefit from the Calm Mind racial trait. 
Frenzied conditions entered this way do not break your spell concentration.
